mutants.name: M1-hex-exclusion-removed
mutants.why: F1 fix: hex digests of 12+ chars must be masked before numeral extraction so their digit-runs are not extracted as declared values. Removing the mask causes hex tokens like 'ab9aa01d50142b45' to contribute spurious numerals.

mutants.name: M2-row-id-fallback-removed
mutants.why: F1 fix: when a pin row has no bold-backtick symbol, the row id from the first cell (P3, M12) becomes the symbol. Removing this fallback means row-id-only rows are never declared.

mutants.name: M3-judge-propagation-rc2-as-pass
mutants.why: F2 fix: exit 2 from propagation_check means 'could not run' — no declarations parsed. Scoring it as PASS manufactures the false confidence this tool exists to prevent.

mutants.name: M4-manifest-propagation-pair-dropped
mutants.why: F3 fix: the emitter's validation: field must carry propagation_check= so the manifest is honest about the tool's state. Dropping the pair makes a NOT_RUN or DIVERGENT plan look like a three-pair manifest when it is actually four.
